description: Source code for SampleVisualQueryDetectionService, a subclass of VisualQueryDetectionService, implementing camera and microphone handling for visual query detection in an Android environment.

classes.name: SampleVisualQueryDetectionService
classes.description: A service that captures camera frames and audio to perform visual query detection, extending VisualQueryDetectionService.

methods.name: onStartDetection
methods.description: Initializes background threads, opens camera, and prepares audio recording.

methods.name: onStopDetection
methods.description: Releases resources and stops background threads.

methods.name: onUpdateState
methods.description: Updates the service state, invoking callback with status.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when service is destroyed.

methods.name: onReceiveImage
methods.description: Processes received camera image, triggers attention, and manages microphone.

methods.name: onReceiveAudio
methods.description: Reads audio data, streams a fake query, and manages sleep for buffer stability.

methods.name: openCamera
methods.description: Opens the camera device and initializes image reader.

methods.name: initializeImageReader
methods.description: Sets up ImageReader for camera output.

methods.name: createCameraPreview
methods.description: Creates camera capture session for preview.

methods.name: updatePreview
methods.description: Updates camera preview settings and requests.

methods.name: releaseResources
methods.description: Releases all camera and audio resources.

methods.name: startBackgroundThread
methods.description: Starts background threads for camera and audio.
